title: Motion-capture source
description: Where a captured clip comes from (backlog X-01): a BVH file under tools/blender/mocap_src (see CREDITS.md) and the time window to fit. tools/blender/build_capture.py fits it to the standard skeleton and writes data/captures/<id>.json. A loop without start_s and cycle_s finds its cleanest cycle within cycle_search_s.

length_s.description: Window length for clips that do not loop.
